metrics.all_case_rule: No invented prediction for failures. Full-test Spearman requires every output to parse; incomplete valid-only correlation is separately labeled.

comparison_to_paper: Original released public test data and native outcome/metric; zero-shot Qwen prompt/representation/training regime differs from native-trained TAPE/ProtST heads.

likely_demands.status: provisional analyst description; internal computation unknown

interpretation.actually_supplied: Archived complete-sequence user prompts and fixed objective; original class ontology supplied for P03. No measurement labels, parent/topology metadata, mutation counts, explanations, retrieval or tools.
interpretation.reference_answer_source: Pinned native DeepLoc curated localization classes or TAPE experimental GFP/folding-stability measurements; scorer-only reference file hashed before inference.
interpretation.good_score_establishes: Recovery of source outcomes on the declared released test under the fixed zero-shot protocol.
interpretation.bad_score_establishes: Limited outcome recovery for this input/regime; does not independently establish deficient general reasoning.
interpretation.explanation_correctness: Unassessed; correct prediction does not certify rationale and unsupported mechanism is not automatically false.

contamination: Reference labels excluded, inputs frozen, outputs hash-locked before scoring, no training or test-guided changes. Prior exposure to public source data unknown.
